patchouli.tcots_witcher.witcher_bestiary: "The Conjunction of the Spheres", this name, so mysterious to a commoner's ear, could be replaced with a much simpler alternative: When the Worlds Collided.$(br2)Learn everything you can about this post-conjunction world if you want to survive, fellow warrior.
tooltip.tcots_witcher.witcher_bestiary: Learn about the dangers of this new world
patchouli.tcots_witcher.alchemy_book.lan: To understand alchemy, you must understand two great truths.$(li)First truth: "As above, so below."$(li)Second truth: "Everything is one."$(br2)These truths teach that alchemical substances are everywhere around you, this is because alchemy is life, and life is alchemy.
